about: Discover advanced slimming and body contouring solutions designed to target the appearance of cellulite, puffiness and water retention. Combining ICOONE technology, lymphatic drainage, Iyashi Dome and detox-inspired body rituals to help smooth, sculpt and leave your body feeling lighter and revitalised.

Powered by the science of salmon DNA and a 360° approach to facial rejuvenation, Valmont's exceptional face and body rituals target visible signs of ageing, restore radiance and enhance skin vitality. Experience Swiss cellular beauty expertise, personalised for timeless, youthful-looking skin.
